source: Heyuan Intelligence Technology, DZ81-MS3UI7C / MS3UI7E3 Modbus register list (xlsx from the manufacturer download page)
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485. The manual lists defaults of address 1, 9600 baud (baud code 3) and 8N1 (serial code 0); baud 1200 to 9600 selectable (code 4 = 19200 is not listed for this model), 8N1, 8O1 or 8E1.

Measured values are read with function 04 (input registers) and settings and the clock with function 03 / 16 (holding). Secondary-side values are 16-bit; primary-side values (secondary x PT or CT) are 32-bit with the high word first.

Addresses are the decimal addresses of the manual (the hexadecimal column has typing errors in places), address base 0. The manual gives scales as magnifying factors (100 for voltage, 1000 for current and power), units from its formula sheet (V, A, kW, kvar, kVA, Hz, kWh).

The register file names the models DZ81-MS3UI7C and MS3UI7E3. The addresses and names of the 50 registers of the earlier unofficial map match this file, so the DZ81 family is mapped from it; the name DZS310 appears in no Heyuan document found, so it is not listed as a model.

Not mapped: the monthly and settlement-day energy blocks of the 0x4000 zone (including the primary-side energy block, whose three-register stride the manual does not explain) and the duplicate relay write zone at 0x5000.
Written from the manufacturer's register list; not tested on a device.
description: Three-phase multifunction power meter: secondary and primary voltages, currents, powers, power factors, frequency, unbalance, harmonics, real-time energy, configuration, clock, digital inputs and relays
